## 主张 Claim

剩余程序与到达条件的共同展开有精确完成／接续对应及原生路径投影。共同语法、原生完整同测与接收侧有限分支恢复每个部分历史的余项和到达答案。插入活动后可接实际后段为一条历史，但插入可使原待用接续失效；同一起点产生的余项差异可迫使任何精确说明区分。 / Joint unfolding of residual programs and reached conditions has exact completion/resumption correspondence and native trace projection. Common syntax, complete native-answer agreement and receiving-side finite branching recover residuals and answers along every partial history. Inserted activity and a current-position suffix join into one trace, but insertion can disable a pending continuation; residual differences reached from one start can force distinctions in every exact account.
